claim_checks.claim: WTW reorganisation and organic by segment
claim_checks.finding: Segment structure moved from four segments (Human Capital & Benefits, Corporate Risk & Broking, Investment Risk & Reinsurance, Benefits Delivery & Administration - still used in the FY2021 release) to two segments (Health, Wealth & Career; Risk & Broking) from 2022. Portfolio changes: Willis Re sold (2021); TRANZACT divested (2025, cutting HWC North America revenue from $3,780m to $3,054m); Newfront acquired (2026; ~42% to HWC, ~58% to R&B); Willis Re JV re-entry (2026, ~$0.30 EPS headwind). Organic by segment: FY2025 HWC +4%, R&B +6%; Q3 2026 HWC +4%, R&B +5%.
FY2025: reported (2)%, CC (3)%, organic 5%. Q3 2026: reported 8%, CC 8%, organic 4%. Adjusted operating margin FY2025 25.2% (+130bp).
Now extracted: US 46.4%, UK 21.3%, Ireland 1.5%, RoW 30.9% (2025).
